newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AMP's PriorityOne cuts home loan rate by 0.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: AMP's PriorityOne cuts home loan rate by 0.5 pct.

text.p: Non-bank mortgage provider AMP's PriorityOne Financial Services said on Monday it would pass on the latest official interest rate cut in full to its "All Options" variable rate loan customers.
The change will reduce its "All Options" variable home loan rate to 6.97 percent from 7.47 percent.
PriorityOne said the lower rate will take effect immediately for new customers and from July 20 for existing customers.
Australia's big four banks have come under attack after reducing variable home loan rates by only 0.35 percentage points to 7.20 percent following Friday's 0.5 point official rate cut.
PriorityOne's new rate is in line with the 6.99 percent offered by other big non-bank mortgage originators.
